user_instruction: 시간·수량별 메모리 검색 구조 설계 및 후보 구현과 비교 조건 검증 진행하자
hypothesis: With one shared observed episode bank, assigning different retrieval distributions to time and quantity can outperform giving both tasks the same mixture of those distributions. Shared addressing has not been established as the cause of previous failures.
baseline: fresh unchanged titantpp B; all base parameters jointly trainable

architecture.base: unchanged two-layer encoder then original static Hard-LMM gives z_B
architecture.query_input: affine-free LayerNorm of observed base encoder hidden before final static Hard-LMM
architecture.records: existing adjacent-valid completed predecessor->successor pairs; no bridge across unobserved valid events
architecture.key: one shared K projection of predecessor hidden
architecture.value: one shared phi(x)=GELU(V*x+b), x=existing successor log1p dt/log1p quantity, width16
architecture.attention: two independently parameterized queries Qt,Qq; softmax(Qtask*shared_K/sqrt(8)) over completed records whose successor is at or before the observed query
architecture.output_projections: independent bias-free 16->H Ut,Uq; both zero initialized
architecture.empty_unobserved: both reads and corrections exactly zero despite trained value bias
architecture.invalid_padding: sanitize unobserved features/hidden before nonlinear operations; unavailable records excluded
architecture.state_lifetime: per sample, reconstructed on each forward; no cross-batch state
architecture.head_objective: original softplus log1p quantity head/direct log-MSE and legacy clamped time head; jointly trained; no new loss or gradient detach

control_interpretation.comparison_scope: task assignment versus shared mixture with symmetric per-task fusion; does not separately establish predecessor-successor association benefit

initialization.shared_B: same seed gives exact B state and caller CPU RNG; new-module construction inside fork_rng(devices=[])
initialization.new_parameters: Qt then Qq then K then V then Ut then Uq; nn.Linear defaults; V bias zero; Ut/Uq weights zero
initialization.within_model: Qt and Qq sampled sequentially and distinct to avoid symmetric-query trap
initialization.between_models: all named trainable tensors exactly equal for same caller RNG; only routing_code int64 buffer differs
initialization.guarantees: initial outputs/objective/common-B preclip gradients match; added output-projection gradients affect total clipping so first clipped optimizer step need not match B
initialization.quantity_path_tests: activate quantity-head weights and both output projections when testing gradient flow; default quantity head weights are zero

capacity.rank_choice: fixed8 for all datasets to keep added parameters under5% for both actual max_len64 and256 while retaining value width16; not a matched comparison to earlier rank16 models
capacity.time_memory_cost: both conditions compute two score matrices and reads; shared mixture adds arithmetic; measure actual CPU step and peak RSS, do not assert identical wall time

comparison_contract_requirements.selector: strict earliest finite validation raw-RMSE minimum
comparison_contract_requirements.reported_metrics: same selected checkpoint RMSE/MAE/body/tail/legacy time; last120 and last30 mean/sampleSD separately
comparison_contract_requirements.gpu_execution_contract_status: not issued; resource assignment/native CUDA/cost/time ceiling require later contract and approval

verification: independent scalar causal-prefix oracle for both query routes and mixture
different task reads for unequal Qt/Qq with fixed bank; equal queries/single record collapse as expected
future target, padded/unobserved values, mask gaps, batch independence
both Qt/Qq/K/V/b/Ut/Uq receive gradients after activation
time-only and quantity-only gradients reach correct query in split; both queries in shared; shared K/V get either task
exact model/optimizer/RNG restore and next-update equality
checkpoint route identity prevents relabeling shared/split/B and foreign payloads
shared training entrypoint synthetic same batches, strict earliest tie and saved/last selected state
synthetic CPU step and memory costs with activated paths at batch128 lengths64/256
limitations: Design is an unvalidated mechanism hypothesis, not a proven performance improvement or novel contribution.
Whole base encoder remains jointly trainable; task-specific retrieval does not eliminate shared-gradient interaction.
Current legacy time loss is a provisional comparison metric; normalized common time likelihood remains separate future work.
No validation-target quantity thresholds or dataset-specific routing rules.
